curve: survival function of log pi over each slide's finite H1 bars, pi = sqrt(death / birth) of the alpha filtration (squared radii); the Betti curve of the bars [0, log pi), fitted by topocyte.ph.FPCA(dim=1)

arms.A: density arm of the slice: 10 density features + log10 cells (as density_adds.py), recomputed

intervals: paired bootstrap over slides of seed-averaged per-slide values, shared indices default_rng(12345).integers(0, 123, (4000, 123))
gate: H1 Betti-curve fPCA of the recomputed diagrams reproduces the saved first 4 scores within 1e-06 (relative, up to sign)
